experiment_scope: finite synthetic directed graphs only; source/core structures generated without biological outcome data

generator.random_generator: xorshift32 deterministic int32: x^=(x<<13)&0xffffffff; x^=x>>17; x^=(x<<5)&0xffffffff; return (x&0xffffffff)/4294967296
generator.initial_random_draws: generate optional non-core source-to-target edges, then optional directed non-source-to-non-source edges, sorted by source ID then target ID; consume a selection draw for every optional edge; if selected consume geographic tier draw, environmental tier draw, barrier draw, hard-unavailable draw
generator.source_core_edges: complete regime: every S_i->S_j (i!=j); cycle regime: only S_i->S_(i+1 mod n_sources); baseline geography=8km, env=0, barrier=0, hard=false
generator.other_candidate_edges: optional S_i->T_j for i>0; optional T_i->T_j (i!=j); no T->S edges; never add duplicate
generator.observation_roster: all n_sources source nodes and all 3 non-source targets are positive, held fixed across source hypotheses; one alternative singleton source hypothesis for each S_i
generator.horizons: ordered [1,2,3,n_nodes-1], where n_nodes=n_sources+3; number of steps means graph hops, not years
generator.paired_design: same optional random edges and requirements for complete/cycle source-core regimes at identical source_count, density_index, seed_index
generator.always_connected_sources: each regime has a baseline strongly connected source core; for n_sources=2 complete and cycle are exactly the same

primary_hypothesis.target: The mean fraction (F_possible minus F_source_robust)/|Theta| at H=n_sources-1 is greater for cycle than complete source core, pooled over all n_sources in {3,4}, two optional densities and 24 paired seeds.
primary_hypothesis.denominator: 96 paired graph draws (2 source counts×2 density cells×24 seeds); not 96 biological independent populations

formal_and_control_checks.test: For every identical graph and threshold, F_possible(H) and F_source_robust(H) each monotonically expand with H (no violations). This is a theorem/implementation check, not empirical novelty.

At H=n_nodes-1, F_possible=F_source_robust for both source-core regimes in every panel, because baseline source nodes are strongly connected, and reachability in finite directed graphs has simple paths <=n_nodes-1.
n_sources=2 cycle graph equals complete graph for each matched seed/density and all horizons, including identical feasible sets and Pareto frontiers.

Native EOG v2 source-uncertain minrelax is applied to predeclared audit subset seed_index=0, all n_sources,densities,regimes at critical H and terminal H, to check independent direct bitset BFS counts/frontiers.
No feasibility from a missing candidate source is imputed; source universe same across modes; changing source roster is a different question.

secondary_descriptives: G1 per n_sources and optional-edge density; strict positive-gap counts and mean gap values
contrast dense vs sparse within cycle (not predeclared causal effect)
H1, H2, H3, Hterminal possible, robust, and gap rates with exact denominators
source-robust Pareto antichain size conditional on at least one feasible source
stop_rules: Use all 24 seed indices without selection by outcome or exclusion of empty possible-set designs
Do not retune edge requirements/probabilities after seeing results
The source-core regime comparison is a controlled synthetic manipulation, not observed connectivity
No random permutation p-value interpreted as independent biological replication
If a native EOG check disagrees with independent BFS, STOP and diagnose before scientific result
Do not add new EOG-WF scored endpoint, true source identification, real dispersal rate or causal ecological claim
Do not merge scientific outcomes if dedicated CI fails; preserve negative/refuted results
